As a Texan ranger, in the Indian wars, delineating western adventure; afterwards a scout and spy, in Tennessee, Alabama, Georgia, and the Carolinas, under General Mitchell, Rosecrans, Stanley, Sheridan, Lytle, Thomas, Crook, and Sherman. Fully illustrating the secret service. Twenty-five full-page engravings, Cincinnati, New York, J.R. Hawley & co., 1865, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/scoutrangerbeing00pike.
